angularDiameterSource: Computed here from the record's radius and distance: 2 x 351,329 km at 86.13 pc = 0.05 mas. No interferometric diameter of this star is used.
distanceSource: Gaia DR3 parallax 11.6104 +/- 0.0166 mas (same row, RUWE 1.24): 86.13 pc, no zero-point correction
radiusSource: Radius 0.505 +/- 0.015 solar radii from Parc et al. 2025, the stellar radius of the default parameter set of TOI-756 b in the NASA Exoplanet Archive (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2025A&A...702A.138P/abstract): 351,329 km at 695,700 km per solar radius. Mass 0.505 +/- 0.019 solar masses from Parc et al. 2025, the stellar mass of the default parameter set of TOI-756 b in the NASA Exoplanet Archive (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2025A&A...702A.138P/abstract); GM is that mass times the JPL solar GM. Temperature 3657 +/- 72 K from Parc et al. 2025, the stellar temperature of the default parameter set of TOI-756 b in the NASA Exoplanet Archive (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2025A&A...702A.138P/abstract). presentationUp: the display axis is a sky-plane convention; the spin axis's position angle on the sky is not measured.
effectiveTemperatureSource: Parc et al. 2025, the stellar temperature of the default parameter set of TOI-756 b in the NASA Exoplanet Archive (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2025A&A...702A.138P/abstract)
surfaceGravitySource: log g from the mass and radius in packages/astronomy/data/bodies/toi-756.json (sources in its physicalNotes), log10(GM/R^2) in cgs: 4.735, rounded to two decimals
spectralTypeSource: NASA Exoplanet Archive, composite parameters of TOI-756 (pscomppars): spectral type M1 V, from Parc et al. 2025 (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2025A&A...702A.138P/abstract)
objectTypeSource: SIMBAD, WT 351: main object type PM*, High Proper Motion Star
metallicitySource: NASA Exoplanet Archive, composite parameters of TOI-756 (pscomppars): [Fe/H] 0.196 dex, from Parc et al. 2025 (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2025A&A...702A.138P/abstract)
luminositySource: NASA Exoplanet Archive, composite parameters of TOI-756 (pscomppars): log10 of the luminosity in solar units -1.38722, from Parc et al. 2025 (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2025A&A...702A.138P/abstract)
ageSource: NASA Exoplanet Archive, composite parameters of TOI-756 (pscomppars): age 3.2 Gyr, from Parc et al. 2025 (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2025A&A...702A.138P/abstract)

shape.qualification: A sphere at the published radius, colored from the star's Gaia DR3 BP/RP spectrum (photometry/stellar-color.json); no image of the photosphere exists.
